verdict.rationale: Highnote documents Collaborative Authorization, which lets your business logic approve or decline transactions in real time (highnote-docs-7). That covers the core of the story. The evidence does not show how it works: no endpoint or webhook contract, no response-time budget, and no timeout fallback you control. Missing for 10: documented endpoint/request-response mechanics for auth decisioning, stated network time budget or latency SLA, a documented and configurable timeout fallback (stand-in approve/decline), independent or hands-on corroboration.
